customer.business: May11Leven Labs, a small design studio (brand identity, websites, apps, 3D, automation, AI agents, content) that markets itself on Instagram
customer.target: Owners and marketing leads of growing businesses that sell on looks and trust: hotels and lodges, real estate, clinics, restaurants and cafes, fashion and beauty brands, schools
customer.where: Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana, South Africa first; UAE and Saudi Arabia second; anywhere else third. Scrolling Instagram on a phone.

behaviours.name: Busy scroller

behaviours.name: Design-aware

behaviours.name: Price-first

pitch:
An Instagram carousel from May11Leven Labs, a design studio, appears in your feed.
Slide 1: the lowercase "a" of a typeface drawn as an outline with its anchor points and dashed guide lines (baseline, x-height, cap height) on cool grey.
Slide 2: a type specimen reading "Quiet / work / that / sells." in three weights and a serif italic.
Slide 3: the studio's two-bar "11" logo with measurements (41, 29, 181, 30): "Two bars. One offset. The eleven, measured."
Slide 4: "Every letter, every mark, drawn on purpose." and "Brand identity, websites, apps, 3D, automation, AI agents and content. Comment 11 for a free first look at yours."
Caption opens: "every letter we set and every mark we draw is measured first."
The offer: comment 11 (or DM) for a free first look at your brand. "buys" here means you would comment 11 or DM them. For the price questions, answer what you would pay in USD for a full brand identity from a studio like this.
